name: The Simpsons
hook: Springfield's first family, and the catchphrases Jeopardy has been quizzing since 1989.

facts.label: Matt Groening
facts.statement: Matt Groening created The Simpsons, which premiered December 17, 1989; its Springfield is named for Springfield, Oregon, and its style grew out of his Life in Hell strips.

facts.label: Springfield
facts.statement: The family lives at Evergreen Terrace in Springfield, a state the show never specifies.

facts.label: D'oh!
facts.statement: Dan Castellaneta's "D'oh!" was scripted as "annoyed grunt" and was inspired by a faux curse in Laurel and Hardy.

facts.label: Ned Flanders
facts.statement: Ned Flanders is the cheery neighbor who says "Okely-dokely"; his wife Maude was voiced by Maggie Roswell.

facts.label: Krusty the Clown
facts.statement: Krusty the Clown endorses products like imitation gruel and Non-Toxic Kologne, and Luke Perry is his half-brother.

facts.label: Montgomery Burns
facts.statement: Montgomery Burns owns Springfield's nuclear plant, is tended by Waylon Smithers, and has a pet monkey named Furious George.

facts.label: Santa's Little Helper
facts.statement: Santa's Little Helper is the family's greyhound, adopted at Christmas, who drinks toilet-bowl water.
